items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Herbert Scott, this fellow that I told you we got from Bessie Smith... Scotty was so long... We were playing... Scotty looked around and said, I believe they got us.

ctx.x: Sure enough. I'll never forget, Herbert Scott, this fellow that I told you we got from Bessie Smith, he was just so elated that he was a musician, of his job and the band and he was just going to let everybody know what his job is, so we stopped at the port of entry once and this guy went in--I think Scotty--I didn't go, I sent Scotty or somebody told me I better go on in, Scotty was so long and the man looked out and said, what's all that on top of the car, (inaudible). They guy just let him talk. We'll be…

I don't have the money for that and I said some kind of tale like it wasn't commercial, so the guy said he would follow us; I guess it wasn't too far away where we were going to play and he said I'll follow you and see what you're doing. So at night, the highway patrol came there and they didn't make me buy no state license, but they made me buy a permit. (Inaudible).
